mentions.name: Open-source personal expense tracker (expense-tracker)
mentions.description: An open-source personal expense tracker that registers tickets by sending them to a Telegram bot and reconciles them against uploaded bank statements. Data ingestion is built first, with reports and additional features planned later, and the design targets the lowest possible usage friction. Bank statement parsing leverages AWS Textract, Bedrock, and BDA, while ticket parsing uses AWS Textract plus parsing rules.
mentions.problem: The author was a happy user of an offline expense tracker that wiped their data when the Play Store decided to auto-update it.
mentions.audience: Registers activity for the author's own personal expense tracking with minimal usage friction.
